title: Two scripted engines, three PVs and suggestion permissions
steps: Expand both engines in analysis-free; inspect three PVs, collapse/reopen and click a suggestion.
Compare analysis-score-only with analysis-live-moves: live-game move suggestions should follow each preference.
Add/remove engines; assign Journey unavailable to exercise engine failure while retaining the other seat.
Change a player to Journey A and make a local move to exercise the UCI player response.
